observed_scope: Ascend910B2C torch 2.9.0 plus torch-npu 2.9.0 MINT fixed checkpoint
RTX 4090 torch 2.9.0+cu128 standard SDPA mixed-dtype and aligned block controls
LeRobot PI0 and OpenPI PI0 fixed-revision static adapter validation
Standard PyTorch SDPA mixed BF16 query and FP32 key/value control
required_before_decision: Run a weight-free cache-path integration probe for every source adapter intended for approval
Provide an independently valid model output reference only before making a model-scoped claim
Freeze separate numerical, performance, and memory limits for the exact prefix-cache adapter and independently rerun them
Repeat CUDA timing on an idle device before making a CUDA performance claim
rollback: Remove the local prefix dtype lookup and cast only after the complete prefix/cache/query path is configured and verified in one intended dtype.
limitations: No fused, quantized, FP8, intentionally heterogeneous QKV, suffix, or mask adapter is covered
Static non-MINT matches are not runtime evidence
CUDA timing was captured under concurrent GPU load and is not suitable for freezing a performance threshold
